## 0.4.8-preview.1

### View Template Snapshot
- Selecting or deselecting a parent category in the import preview now selects or deselects all of its layers and settings, including folded ones; Select All and Deselect All do the same

### Model Health
- New Model Health tool with review checks (assembly codes, workset hygiene, naming, pinning, required parameters, units/levels, coordinates, CAD/point clouds, unused content, views on sheets) and autosaved settings
- Reworked Model Health window with navigation and a reusable result table; results can navigate to elements in Revit

### Align Viewports
- Match Viewports Vertically renamed to Align Viewports, with an orientation choice; added to the ribbon

### Other tools
- Move to Geo-Reference: pinned elements window and transformer updates
- Batch Link Files, Filter By Parameter and Level Extents updated

### General
- User preferences migrated from XML to JSON, with one-time import of existing XML settings
- Daily shared log files with a size cap and process ID tagging
